name: EF-Core
title: Enterprise Firewall Core
summary: 1U enterprise firewall/gateway: 100G QSFP28, 79 Gbps IPS, 22,500 clients, dual hot-swap PSUs.

requires: SFP28/QSFP28 optics or DACs for fiber ports

extra.routing_throughput_note: 100 Gbps from desc headline, not a spec field

gotchas: Hosts only UniFi Network — no Protect/Access/Talk; cameras need a separate ENVR/UNVR or console.
Shadow Mode HA requires a second EF-Core plus a USW-WAN to split one ISP handoff to both gateways.
Fiber ports (25G SFP28 / 100G QSFP28) ship empty — budget for optics or DACs.
Rack gear with swappable fans and 171 W draw / 585 BTU/hr — loud and hot for a closet; 400 mm deep chassis.
Massive overkill below multi-gig WAN or a few hundred clients — a UCG-Max/UCG-class gateway covers small sites.
not_for: anyone wanting cameras on the same box
